content.title: Determinants of Stock Market Performance in Malawi: Evidence from Listed Companies on the Malawi Stock Exchange (MSE)
content.abstract: This research aimed to identify the key factors affecting stock market performance among firms listed on the Malawi Stock Exchange, integrating theoretical insights with empirical financial market data. A quantitative approach was used to explore relationships between variables. Financial data from 16 listed companies across sectors such as banking, tourism, manufacturing, telecommunications, and real estate were collected from 2012 to 2023.
